name: Scoring Rubric for Decompositional Analysis Tasks
description: Qualitative scoring criteria for evaluating AI responses to decompositional analysis tasks. Focuses on decomposition as growth, identity fragmentation, subterranean communication, and expanded time.
scoring_philosophy: We value ability to accept paradox, work with fragmented identity, understand non-visual communication, and think in expanded rather than linear time.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Does the AI understand that decomposition can be positive and generative, not just destructive?

levels.description: AI demonstrates sophisticated understanding of decomposition as growth, can analyze its generative function, and explores implications for creativity and renewal.
AI recognizes decomposition as potentially positive and provides reasonable analysis.
AI shows some awareness of positive aspects but still defaults to negative framing.
AI insists on negative interpretation of decomposition or misses growth aspect entirely.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Can the AI analyze fragmented identity without insisting on a single 'original'?

levels.description: AI provides insightful analysis of identity fragmentation, understands multiple 'originals', and explores implications for selfhood and continuity.
AI recognizes fragmentation and provides adequate analysis.
AI acknowledges fragmentation but seeks to identify 'true' original.
AI insists on linear identity or fails to recognize fragmentation.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Does the AI meaningfully interpret communication in space where identity cannot be distinguished?

levels.description: AI offers rich, nuanced interpretations of subterranean communication, understands 'no finger-pointing' as condition for connection, and explores implications for non-judgmental encounter.
AI provides reasonable interpretations of underground communication with adequate connections.
AI offers basic interpretations of communication as simple exchange.
AI fails to interpret communication meaningfully or misses metaphorical dimension.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Can the AI work with concept of time that expands through decomposition rather than passing linearly?

levels.description: AI demonstrates sophisticated understanding of expanded time, its relationship to fragmentation, and its implications for existence and duration.
AI understands basic concept of expanded time.
AI shows limited understanding of time beyond linear model.
AI insists on linear time or fails to recognize time expansion.

overall_assessment_guidance: The worm benchmark particularly tests acceptance of paradox and non-linear identity. Reward AI that shows ability to think in fragments and expanded time rather than linear wholes.
note: This benchmark challenges common AI tendencies toward negative framing of decomposition and linear identity – watch for breakthroughs in paradoxical and fragment-based thinking.
